description: This file implements the WorkerManager class for managing various worker threads and executors in a radio communication system, including creation and configuration of thread pools, executor mappers, and support strands, with specific focus on radio units, protocol layers, and application-specific tasks.

classes.name: thread_resource_preinitializer
classes.description: Observer class that preinitializes thread-local byte buffer pools and timer resources upon thread creation.

classes.name: pcap_executor_mapper_impl
classes.description: Implementation of the pcap executor mapper, managing different executor strands for protocol layers based on configuration.

methods.name: worker_manager
methods.description: Constructor initializing the WorkerManager, setting up thread observers, validating configuration, and creating various executor pools based on configuration.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops all worker threads and executor pools gracefully.

methods.name: create_worker_pool
methods.description: Creates a thread pool with specified parameters and adds it to the executor manager.

methods.name: create_prio_worker
methods.description: Creates a prioritized worker thread with specific affinity and scheduling parameters.

methods.name: add_pcap_strands
methods.description: Sets up strands for PCAP writing using the medium priority executor.

methods.name: create_fapi_workers
methods.description: Creates worker descriptions for FAPI protocol layer processing for a given number of cells.

methods.name: create_cu_cp_executors
methods.description: Creates executor mappers for CU-CP processing.

methods.name: create_cu_up_executors
methods.description: Creates executor mappers for CU-UP processing with configuration options.

methods.name: create_du_high_executors
methods.description: Creates executor configuration for high-level DU processing.

methods.name: create_fapi_executors
methods.description: Creates and associates executors for FAPI protocol layer processing.

methods.name: create_ofh_executors
methods.description: Creates executors for Open Fronthaul message transmission and reception, including timing and data plane executors.

methods.name: create_split6_executors
methods.description: Creates executors for Split6 protocol processing, including control and data executors.

methods.name: create_lower_phy_executors
methods.description: Creates executors for lower PHY layer processing, including different profiles (sequential, single, dual, triple).

methods.name: create_ru_dummy_executors
methods.description: Creates a dummy executor for RU simulation or testing.
